entries.name: Type ramp
entries.note: Built — #238 took the ramp and the breakpoints off this frame.

entries.name: Color
entries.note: Mislabelled in the file — the canvas is Color and the frame inside it says Typography. All 13 swatches are in the token file; #224 closed this audit as done.

entries.name: Breakpoints
entries.note: Built — #238.

entries.name: Effects
entries.note: A Tailwind shadow cheat sheet with no brand value — #224 closed this audit as done. Tracked so a real effect arriving here is news.

entries.name: Button
entries.note: Axis is unnamed (`Property 1` = Solid | Red CTA | Link) — the Framer import draws no hover, focus or disabled state. Geometry work is its own ticket.

entries.name: Button, white CTA
entries.note: A bare COMPONENT beside the set, not a fourth member of it. The fill the set does not draw.

entries.name: Button icons
entries.note: Arrow in black and white, plus a link glyph. Inline SVG, never a font (ADR 0009).

entries.name: Phosphor icons
entries.note: Missing — 18 glyphs the feature list needs and no component draws (#237 story 6).

entries.name: Card icon
entries.note: Missing — the plated 48px icon the icon cards carry.

entries.name: Mark glyph
entries.note: The mark's X on its own, black and white. Drawn by the same component as the wordmark (#228).

entries.name: Icon slot
entries.note: A Material Symbols placeholder, the same building block O3's file carries. No component — ADR 0009.

entries.name: Icon card
entries.note: Needs `feature.icon` — one of #237's six additive schema changes.

entries.name: Action icon card
entries.note: The icon card with a link affordance. Same block, another variant — the split is the component ticket's to decide.

entries.name: Key metric card
entries.note: One of #224's four structural divergences. The kit draws a yellow plate; `Stat` draws a rule and a number, and `accent` is a brand-only role the shared package may not name (brand-token seam).

entries.name: Yellow text card
entries.note: Missing — one of #224's six. An accent-plated copy card with no counterpart.

entries.name: Yellow text card row
entries.note: Missing, with its card.

entries.name: Case study card
entries.note: One of #224's four structural divergences. The axis is six named clients rather than a shape, so the set records six instances of one anatomy.

entries.name: Strategy card
entries.note: A full-width copy row. No block composes it; #224's parity audit says whether it earns one.

entries.name: Strategy card stack
entries.note: With its card.

entries.name: Insight image
entries.note: The imagery library — six named rasters, content rather than component. Out of scope per #224.

entries.name: Insight image layout
entries.note: Crops of the imagery library at card size. Out of scope with it.

entries.name: O3XO mark
entries.note: Built — #228. Three axes: Color (2 color | White | Black), Layout (Horizontal | Stacked), Background (Yes | No). The kit contradicts itself on the 2-colour XO fill; the plated reading won and the contradiction is Nick's to settle.

entries.name: Site nav
entries.note: One of #224's four structural divergences — the kit's nav has dropdowns and the shared pill does not. Chrome forks per app when this is picked up, not before (#237).

entries.name: Site footer
entries.note: One of #224's four structural divergences.

entries.name: Footer CTA
entries.note: The kit draws the closing CTA as part of the footer; the content model composes it as a band.

entries.name: Footer block
entries.note: Footer CTA and footer stacked — the whole end of the page, which is what a route renders.

entries.name: Person card
entries.note: Needs `person.bio` — one of #237's six additive schema changes. The axis is four named people rather than a shape.

entries.name: Header pill
entries.note: Missing — one of #224's six. The kit's section eyebrow (#237 story 7); `Eyebrow` draws a rule and a word, not a pill.

entries.name: Slide quote
entries.note: A deck slide component. Out of scope per #224 — the kit doubles as a presentation template.

entries.name: FAQ accordion
entries.note: Missing — one of #224's six, and the only interactive component in the kit. #237 adds a `faqSection` block to the O3XO roster.

entries.name: Event band
entries.note: A band with no counterpart. #224's parity audit says whether o3xo.ai still runs it.

entries.name: Pager
entries.note: Built — #241. Numbered pages with prev/next, which is what the kit draws.

entries.name: Hero band
entries.note: Full-bleed photograph under a tint — one of the seven bands #224 said needed a background affordance. `backgroundMedia` landed with #239.

entries.name: Strategy band
entries.note: A two-column text band. Which block composes it is #224's parity audit's to say.

entries.name: Expertise band
entries.note: Icon cards on a photograph. Candidate is `FeatureGridSection` plus `backgroundMedia` (#239); the assignment is the component ticket's.

entries.name: Quote band
entries.note: Wants the header pill as its eyebrow — one of #237's six additive schema changes.

entries.name: Text card band
entries.note: Yellow text cards, which are missing. Blocked on the card.

entries.name: FAQ band
entries.note: Accordion on a photograph. Blocked on the `faqSection` block.

entries.name: Action card band
entries.note: Action icon cards on a cityscape. Candidate is `FeatureGridSection` plus `backgroundMedia` (#239).

entries.name: Three card band
entries.note: Three icon cards, flat. Candidate is `FeatureGridSection`.

entries.name: Wide band, 1920 (824h)
entries.note: Two frames on this canvas are called `Section` and drawn at 1920 rather than 1440. Untriaged — #224's parity audit names them or rules them out.

entries.name: Wide band, 1920 (1090h)
entries.note: The taller of the two 1920 frames. Untriaged, with the other.

ignoredNodeIds.name: Galaxy Background 2
ignoredNodeIds.note: A raster parked on the Cards canvas, not a card. Imagery, and out of scope per #224.

ignoredNodeIds.name: image 1
ignoredNodeIds.note: A loose rectangle on the Cards canvas — scratch, not a component.

ignoredNodeIds.name: Slide Card Components
ignoredNodeIds.note: The deck-slide section. Out of scope per #224, and hashing it would pull a 4041×3309 subtree for work no site renders.

ignoredNodeIds.name: Get started
ignoredNodeIds.note: Figma's own icon-library onboarding frame, left on the Icons canvas.

ignoredNodeIds.name: Light
ignoredNodeIds.note: An icon swatch board beside the sets it swatches.

ignoredNodeIds.name: Dark
ignoredNodeIds.note: The dark half of the same swatch board.

ignoredNodeIds.name: Quote Section
ignoredNodeIds.note: The quote band, drawn twice — this copy and `4406:6954` on the Layouts canvas are the same 1440×372 composition. The Layouts one is tracked.

ignoredNodeIds.name: Light Mode
ignoredNodeIds.note: The pagination study that predates the `Numbers` component. `4404:1821` is what #241 built against.

ignoredNodeIds.name: Imagery
ignoredNodeIds.note: The pattern-raster library. Content rather than component, and a 6612×1977 section: cited by the component map, deliberately not hashed.
